title: Headlines, descriptions, captions and calls to action

say: Test headlines with the 4 U's: useful, urgent, unique and ultra-specific. For example, Chioma runs a laundry in Enugu. Best Laundry Services in Town scores on none of them.

panel.heading: Chioma's laundry headline
right: Resumption week: drop off by Thursday

say: Her new line: Busy in Enugu? Your clothes washed, ironed and delivered in 48 hours. For the season: resumption week, drop off by Thursday, wear crisp uniforms on Monday.
Clear beats clever. Write ten headlines in ten minutes, then choose the best, never the first.

panel.heading: Chioma's laundry headline
right: Resumption week: drop off by Thursday

say: For example, Amaka sells whipped shea butter in Abuja. Her old description said: Organic shea butter. Very good for skin. Organic is a claim she cannot prove, and very good is vague.

panel.heading: The four-part description
items: Hook: the main benefit
Benefits, each with a feature as proof
Practical details: size, ingredients, price
Call to action: what to send

say: Part one, the hook: Soft, whipped shea butter that melts into dry skin without leaving you oily.

panel.heading: The four-part description
items: Hook: the main benefit
Benefits, each with a feature as proof
Practical details: size, ingredients, price
Call to action: what to send

say: Part two, benefits with proof: made with raw shea butter and coconut oil, so it absorbs quickly. Whipped for 20 minutes, so it spreads easily, even in harmattan.

panel.heading: The four-part description
items: Hook: the main benefit
Benefits, each with a feature as proof
Practical details: size, ingredients, price
Call to action: what to send

say: Part three, details: a 250g jar, the real ingredients, how to store it, the price of 4,500 naira, and delivery in 1 to 2 days.

panel.heading: The four-part description
items: Hook: the main benefit
Benefits, each with a feature as proof
Practical details: size, ingredients, price
Call to action: what to send

say: Part four, the action: Reply SHEA with your area to order.

panel.heading: The four-part description
items: Hook: the main benefit
Benefits, each with a feature as proof
Practical details: size, ingredients, price
Call to action: what to send

say: Never claim a product cures or treats a disease unless it is approved for that. Food, drinks and cosmetics sold widely generally need NAFDAC registration.

panel.heading: The four-part description
items: Hook: the main benefit
Benefits, each with a feature as proof
Practical details: size, ingredients, price
Call to action: what to send
panel.rule: No 'organic' or health claims you cannot prove.

say: Words like quality, big and fast tell the buyer nothing she can check.

panel.heading: Vague words, specific words
right: 5 litres, a week of family cooking
Same-day in Ikeja, order by noon

say: Replace them with details: double-stitched seams and a metal zip. 5 litres, enough for a week of family cooking. Same-day delivery in Ikeja if you order before 12 noon. Specific words sound like someone who has really used the product.

panel.heading: Vague words, specific words
right: 5 litres, a week of family cooking
Same-day in Ikeja, order by noon

say: One idea per status. For example, Tolu sells small chops in Ibadan. Instead of one crowded flyer with 12 items, she posts a series. Morning: planning a party this weekend? 50 packs ready in 24 hours.

panel.heading: Tolu's five-status day
items: Morning: party this weekend?
Proof: fried fresh on the day
Details: what is in each pack, price
Customer message, with permission
Evening: 3 more orders, reply PACK

say: Then a video of puff-puff frying: fresh, not reheated.

panel.heading: Tolu's five-status day
items: Morning: party this weekend?
Proof: fried fresh on the day
Details: what is in each pack, price
Customer message, with permission
Evening: 3 more orders, reply PACK

say: Then what is in each pack, at about 2,000 naira this month.

say: Then a customer's thank-you message, shared with permission.

say: And in the evening: I can take 3 more weekend orders. Reply PACK with the date and number of guests. Together, the series follows Attention, Interest, Desire and Action.

say: Instagram cuts a caption off after the first line or two, so the first line must work like a headline. For example, Bisi sells adire in Abeokuta: Every piece was tied and dyed by hand, so no two wrappers are the same.
Then the story, details with price, one action, and specific hashtags like adire and Abeokuta, not general ones like love.

panel.heading: Caption checklist
items: First line works like a headline
Value: a tip or the product's story
Proof and details, with price
One call to action
A handful of specific hashtags

say: Patronise us is not a call to action. Use a clear verb, like reply, book or order, and one channel, the one you answer fastest.

panel.heading: Make ordering one tap
items: One clear verb and one channel
The exact next step to send
Price and delivery cost shown first
Say how payment works
A wa.me link with a pre-filled message

say: Give the exact next step: reply ORDER with your delivery area and I will send the total.

panel.heading: Make ordering one tap
items: One clear verb and one channel

Say how payment works
A wa.me link with a pre-filled message

say: Remove friction. Show the price and the delivery cost before the call to action.

panel.heading: Make ordering one tap
items: One clear verb and one channel
The exact next step to send
Price and delivery cost shown first
Say how payment works
A wa.me link with a pre-filled message

say: Say how payment works, and add reassurance, like your response time or exchange policy.

panel.heading: Make ordering one tap
items: One clear verb and one channel
The exact next step to send
Price and delivery cost shown first
Say how payment works
A wa.me link with a pre-filled message

say: A WhatsApp click-to-chat link opens a chat with you in one tap. Grace in Abuja types wa.me, then her number with 234 instead of the first 0, and adds a message so the customer only presses send. She tests it on her own phone first.

panel.heading: Make ordering one tap
items: One clear verb and one channel
The exact next step to send
Price and delivery cost shown first
Say how payment works
A wa.me link with a pre-filled message

say: Ask buyers to pay only into an account in your business or registered name, and never ask for card PINs, OTPs or passwords. Saying this in your copy reassures buyers who fear scams.

panel.heading: Make ordering one tap
items: One clear verb and one channel
The exact next step to send
Price and delivery cost shown first
Say how payment works
A wa.me link with a pre-filled message
panel.rule: Pay only into your business account. Never ask for PINs or OTPs.

say: To remember. Ten headlines, checked with the 4 U's. Hook, benefits, details and action. Specific words and only true claims. One idea per status. And one easy step to order.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Write ten headlines; check the 4 U's
Hook, benefits, details, action
Specific words, only true claims
One idea per status, in a series
One verb, one channel, one easy step

say: Your turn. Write ten headlines in ten minutes. Rewrite three product descriptions. Post a five-status series and count the replies. And build and test your click-to-chat link.
